newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador grants YPF new drilling rights.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador grants YPF new drilling rights.

text.p: Ecuador's government Wednesday awarded Argentine oil giant YPF rights to drill in two new oilfields, the Energy and Mining Ministry said in a statement.

"The National Hydrocarbons Board issued technical criteria which guarantee the rational use of renewable natural resources by officially incorporating these oilfields into national production," the statement said.
It said the board will regulate production levels at the two oilfields, Daimi and Ginta, which are located in "Block 16" of the Amazon jungle.
Ecuador is the third largest oil exporter in Latin America and oil is its largest industry.
YPF operates in Ecuador through its U.S. subsidiary Maxus.
No company officials could be reached to comment on production aspects or the oilfield reserves.
